aril.note: Each sample preserves 192 time steps, 52 subcarriers, one Tx, one Rx, plus matching gesture and location labels.

csi-bench.note: Time uses the task profile; native subcarrier, Tx, and Rx dimensions are preserved. Flattened source links are recorded as 1 Tx by L Rx.

csida.note: The source [sample, time, 3 Rx, 114 subcarrier] array becomes [sample, time, 114 subcarrier, 1 Tx, 3 Rx]. Keep all csi_label_* Zarr arrays beside csi_data_amp; phase is used when present.

ehunam.note: Null carriers are removed; the sample keeps 1 Tx × 1 Rx.

exposing-csi.note: The adapter FFT-shifts AX-CSI, removes official null bins, and preserves four monitor streams as 1 Tx × 4 Rx.

figshare-csi-har.note: The four released MIMO links become 2 Tx × 2 Rx; keep label.csv beside data.csv.

glasgow-activity-localization.note: The official processed USRP-OFDM amplitude sample keeps 1 Tx × 1 Rx.

glasgow-multiuser.note: The class directory is retained as provenance; the sample keeps 1 Tx × 1 Rx.

mm-fi.note: Each released CSIamp frame is [3 Rx, 114 subcarriers, 10 packet captures]; the adapter unfolds every capture into time and keeps 1 Tx × 3 Rx.

nist-breathesmart.note: Keep the matching imaginary log and config CSV. The adapter removes all-zero reserved slots and retains 56 measured subcarriers × 2 Tx × 3 Rx.

ntu-fi.note: The source [3 antenna,114 subcarrier,2000 packet] payload follows SenseFi's every-fourth-packet selection and becomes [500,114,1,3]. Raw and officially normalized amplitude arrays are both retained.

operanet.note: Order tx1rx1_sub1 through tx3rx3_sub30 into [T,30,3,3], retain real/imaginary/amplitude/phase plus activity/person/room/experiment metadata, and infer effective cadence from the full timestamp span.

signfi.note: Each clip retains complex CSI, 30 subcarriers, and 1 Tx × 3 Rx.

ut-har.note: Each upstream processed clip is 250 time × 30 subcarriers × 1 Tx × 3 Rx.

wallhack18k.note: Interleaved imaginary/real samples are parsed; the documented 52 subcarriers and 1 × 1 link stay native.

wiar.note: Intel 5300 records provide the real Tx/Rx counts, which are retained instead of flattened.

widar3.note: This benchmark release stores processed BVP rather than raw CSI.

wifi-80mhz.note: The official [(T × 4), 242] complex matrix is deinterleaved into four monitor streams; only time is resampled for a task view.

wifi-presence-movement.note: Gzip JSON Lines preserve complex CSI with 30 subcarriers and 1 Tx × 3 Rx.

wifi-tad.note: Keep the annotations directory beside smartwifi to attach temporal activity segments.

wimans.note: Both official branches preserve 30 subcarriers and the 3 Tx × 3 Rx layout.

wipe-fall.note: Keep the six official folders intact. The amplitude-only release has 51 subcarriers and one USRP transmitter–receiver link.

wireless-har-wifi-uwb.note: The Room 2 MAT table stores 90 named CSI columns as 3 Rx × 30 subcarriers. The mini sample is WiFi-only; it does not invent UWB axes.

xrf-v2.note: The authentic source [T, receiver device, channel stream, 30 subcarriers] tensor becomes canonical [T, 30, logical Tx, Rx]. Both 3-valued source axes stay explicit; the channel stream axis is not claimed to be a physical Tx antenna.

xrf55.note: The authentic source [270 flattened receive-stream/subcarrier rows, 1000 time steps] becomes [T, 30 subcarriers, 1 Tx, 9 Rx]. The nine streams are three receiver devices × three receiving antennas; they are not 3 Tx × 3 Rx.
